risks: Malformed-JSON errors change from plain text to a JSON body.
Previously accepted blank titles are now rejected; any client sending them will start seeing 400s.
trade_offs: Trim-and-store rather than rejecting padded titles: friendlier, but the stored value differs from what was sent.
Fixed 200-character limit in code rather than configuration: simpler, but changing it needs a deploy.
failure_scenarios: A client sends a 1 MB body: MaxBytesReader stops decoding at 64 KiB and returns 400 instead of buffering it.
guardrails: ValidateTitle is table-tested at the boundary, including multi-byte characters.
HTTP tests assert rejected requests store nothing.
